name: honest-arcade
description: Ad-free games built with three.js and plain web tech: puzzles and slot machines with play money. Playable in the browser, packaged for Android (and later iOS) with Capacitor.

scripts.test: node tests/puzzles.mjs && node tests/economy.mjs && npm run test:slots && npm run build -- --experimental && node tests/smoke.mjs && node tests/slots/e2e.mjs
scripts.test:slots: node scripts/slots-validate.mjs && node --test tests/slots/*.test.mjs && node scripts/slots-sim.mjs --check
